title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice on Carrying Out Pilot Work of Lawyer Mediation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court and Ministry of Justice — Opinions on Carrying Out Pilot Work on Lawyer Mediation

SF [2017] No. 105

To the High People's Courts and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of Beijing, Heilongjiang, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Shandong, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, and Sichuan provinces (municipalities directly under the Central Government):

In order to implement the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Comprehensively Advancing the Rule of Law, the Opinions on Improving the Multi-dimensional Dispute Resolution Mechanism, the Opinions on Deepening the Reform of the Lawyer System issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council, and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening the Reform of the Multi-dimensional Dispute Resolution Mechanism, to fully leverage the professional, occupational, and practical advantages of lawyers in preventing and resolving disputes, to improve the lawyer mediation system, and to promote the formation of a multi-dimensional dispute resolution system with Chinese characteristics, the following opinions are hereby put forward regarding the pilot work on lawyer mediation.

I. General Requirements

1. Guiding Ideology. We shall fully implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third, Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee, thoroughly implement the spirit of the important speeches of General Secretary Xi Jinping and his important instructions on lawyer work, focus on the overall goal of comprehensively advancing the rule of law, deepen the reform of the multi-dimensional dispute resolution mechanism, improve the working mechanism for the connection between litigation and mediation, fully leverage the functional role of lawyers, establish a lawyer mediation work model, innovate lawyer mediation methods and techniques, effectively resolve various disputes, protect the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, promote social fairness and justice, and maintain social harmony and stability.

2. Basic Principles.

-- Adherence to lawful mediation. Lawyer mediation shall be conducted in accordance with the law, shall not violate the prohibitive provisions of laws and regulations, and shall not harm national interests, social public interests, or the legitimate rights and interests of the parties and other interested persons.

-- Adherence to equality and voluntariness. When conducting mediation, lawyers shall fully respect the will of all parties, respect the parties' right to choose the procedure for dispute resolution, and protect their litigation rights.

-- Adherence to neutrality in mediation. Lawyer mediation shall remain neutral, shall not have any words or actions that favor any party, and shall maintain the objectivity, fairness, and acceptability of the mediation result.

-- Adherence to confidentiality in mediation. Unless all parties agree otherwise or the law provides otherwise, the mediation matters, mediation process, and content of the mediation agreement shall not be disclosed, and the personal privacy or trade secrets of the parties shall not be leaked.

-- Adherence to convenience and efficiency. In conducting mediation, lawyers using their professional knowledge shall focus on work efficiency, flexibly determine the mediation methods, techniques, and procedures based on the actual circumstances of the dispute, and establish a convenient and efficient working mechanism.

-- Adherence to effective connection. We shall strengthen the organic connection between lawyer mediation and people's mediation, administrative mediation, industry mediation, commercial mediation, and litigation mediation, fully leverage their respective characteristics and advantages, and form a dispute resolution mechanism with procedural connection, complementary advantages, and collaboration.

II. Establishing a Lawyer Mediation Work Model

Lawyer mediation refers to the activity in which a lawyer, a law firm mediation studio, or a lawyer mediation center established in accordance with the law acts as an independent third party to preside over mediation, assisting the parties to a dispute in reaching an agreement to resolve the dispute through voluntary negotiation.

3. Establish lawyer mediation studios in People's Courts. People's courts at all levels in the pilot areas shall combine lawyer mediation with the construction of litigation service centers, establish lawyer mediation studios in the litigation service centers, litigation-mediation connection centers, or qualified people's tribunals of the People's Courts, and equip them with necessary work facilities and work spaces.

4. Establish lawyer mediation studios in public legal service centers (stations). County-level public legal service centers and township-level public legal service stations in the pilot areas shall establish dedicated lawyer mediation studios, where the public legal service centers (stations) shall assign lawyer mediators to provide public welfare mediation services.

5. Establish lawyer mediation centers in lawyer associations. Provincial-level and city-level (divided into districts) lawyer associations in the pilot areas shall establish lawyer mediation centers. Under the guidance of the lawyer association, the lawyer mediation center shall organize lawyers to act as mediators, accept applications from parties or referrals from People's Courts, and participate in conflict resolution and dispute mediation.

6. Establish mediation studios in law firms. Qualified law firms are encouraged and supported to establish mediation studios, form mediation teams, carry out the acceptance of party applications for mediation as part of their legal practice, and may also accept mediation cases referred by People's Courts and administrative organs.

III. Improving the Lawyer Mediation Working Mechanism

7. Clarify the scope of lawyer mediation cases. Lawyer mediation may accept various types of civil and commercial disputes, including the civil part of criminal附带 civil disputes, except for cases concerning the confirmation of marriage relationships, status relationships, or other cases that cannot be mediated due to their nature.

8. Establish and improve the qualification management system for lawyer mediation work. The provincial-level judicial administrative organs and lawyer associations in the pilot areas, together with the People's Courts, shall study and formulate management measures, specifying the qualification conditions for law firms and lawyers undertaking lawyer mediation work, including but not limited to the size of personnel, years of practice, number of cases handled, and integrity status. The judicial administrative organs and lawyer associations, together with the People's Courts, shall establish a roster of law firms and lawyer mediators undertaking lawyer mediation work.

9. Standardize the procedures for lawyer mediation work. People's Courts, public legal service centers (stations), lawyer associations, and law firms shall provide the parties with a roster of law firms and lawyer mediators undertaking lawyer mediation work, and publish the roster information on bulletin boards, official websites, and other platforms for the convenience of party inquiries and selection.

When law firms and lawyers accept relevant commissioned representation or participate in dispute resolution, they shall inform the parties to優先選擇調解或其他非訴訟方式解決糾紛。优先选择调解或其他非诉讼方式解决纠纷。

Lawyer mediation shall generally be presided over by one mediator. For cases that are major, difficult, complex, or where the parties request mediation by two or more mediators, mediation may be conducted by two or more mediators, and the lawyer mediation studio or lawyer mediation center shall designate one mediator to preside. If the parties have justified reasons, they may apply for the replacement of the lawyer mediator. The lawyer mediator shall conduct mediation work in accordance with the mediation procedures. The period for lawyer mediation shall be 30 days, unless both parties agree to extend the mediation period. If an agreement is reached through mediation, a mediation agreement shall be issued; if no agreement is reached within the period and the parties do not agree to continue mediation, the mediation shall be terminated.

When organizing mediation, the lawyer mediator shall record the disputed matters and the mediation status in writing and have them signed and confirmed by both parties. The lawyer mediation studio or lawyer mediation center shall establish complete electronic and paper written mediation files for party inquiries. When the mediation procedure concludes and the parties fail to reach a mediation agreement, the lawyer mediator may, after obtaining the consent of all parties, record in writing the facts on which there is no dispute during the mediation process, and have them signed and confirmed by the parties. In litigation proceedings, unless it involves national interests, social public interests, or the legitimate rights and interests of others, the parties need not adduce evidence regarding the undisputed facts confirmed during the mediation process.

When a lawyer mediation organization established at a public legal service center (station), lawyer association, or law firm accepts a party's direct application to preside over mediation of a dispute, the above procedures shall be followed mutatis mutandis.

10. Encourage prompt performance of mediation agreements. When parties reach a mediation agreement through mediation by a lawyer mediation studio or a lawyer mediation center, the lawyer mediator shall encourage and guide the parties to perform the agreement promptly. If a party refuses or delays performance without justifiable reasons, the costs related to mediation and enforcement shall be borne wholly or partially by the party that failed to perform the agreement.

11. Improve the mechanism for connecting mediation agreements with payment orders. Where the settlement agreement or mediation agreement reached through lawyer mediation involves payment of money or negotiable securities, and the creditor applies to the competent basic-level People's Court for a payment order in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law and its judicial interpretations, the People's Court shall issue a payment order according to law; if the debtor fails to raise a written objection within the statutory period and fails to perform the payment order within the prescribed time limit, the People's Court may enforce it by compulsory means.

12. Improve the judicial confirmation procedure for mediation agreements. For agreements with the nature of civil contracts reached through mediation by a lawyer mediation studio or a lawyer mediation center, the parties may apply to the basic-level People's Court or people's tribunal in the locality of the lawyer mediation studio or lawyer mediation center for confirmation of their validity, and the People's Court shall confirm the validity of the mediation agreement according to law.

13. Establish a lawyer mediator disqualification system. A party has the right to apply for disqualification of a lawyer mediator in the following circumstances: being a close relative of a party or its agent; having an interest in the dispute; having other relationships with the parties or agents that may affect fair mediation. If a lawyer mediator falls under the above circumstances and the party requests disqualification, the lawyer mediator shall be disqualified; if the party does not request disqualification, the lawyer mediator shall promptly inform the party and voluntarily withdraw. If all parties agree to continue mediation, the lawyer mediator may continue to preside over the mediation.

A lawyer mediator shall not accept the commission of a party to act as an agent in arbitration or litigation concerning the disputed matter or other disputes closely related to it, nor shall he or she serve as a people's assessor, arbitrator, witness, expert, or interpreter in any subsequent procedures for resolving the disputed matter.

14. Establish a scientific funding guarantee mechanism. Where a mediation studio established in a law firm accepts a party's direct application for mediation of a dispute, it may charge mediation fees from both parties based on the principles of paid service and low pricing, unless one party agrees to bear all costs. The standards and methods for charging mediation fees shall be determined by each pilot area based on actual circumstances and submitted to relevant departments for approval and filing.

Where a lawyer mediation studio established in a public legal service center (station) or a lawyer mediation center established in a lawyer association accepts a party's direct application for mediation of a dispute, the funding shall be resolved by the judicial administrative organs and lawyer associations through government procurement of services. The funding for lawyer mediators mediating legal aid cases shall be resolved by legal aid institutions through government procurement of services.

Where a lawyer mediation studio is established in a People's Court, the People's Court shall resolve mediation funding through government procurement of services based on the quantity, quality, and social effects of dispute mediation, and include it in the special budget of the People's Court. The specific methods shall be determined by each pilot area based on actual circumstances.

15. Leverage the leverage of litigation costs. If the parties reach a settlement agreement and apply for withdrawal of the lawsuit, the People's Court shall waive the litigation costs. If, during litigation, the parties reach a mediation agreement through mediation, the People's Court may reduce the litigation costs by half. If a party fails to participate in mediation without justifiable reasons, or has obvious malice leading to the failure of mediation, the People's Court may, depending on the specific circumstances, support the reasonable request of the non-fault party to claim reasonable attorney fees and other legitimate claims in accordance with the law.

IV. Strengthening Work Guarantees

16. Strengthen organizational leadership. People's Courts, judicial administrative organs, and lawyer associations in the pilot areas shall attach great importance to this reform work, strengthen institutional construction and work coordination, and effectively promote the smooth development of the pilot work. Within the framework of the lawyer mediation system, they shall innovate work methods and techniques, formulate implementation opinions suitable for the characteristics of their respective regions, continuously summarize experiences, actively explore, and provide replicable and referable systems and experiences for nationwide promotion.

17. Actively guide participation. People's Courts, judicial administrative organs, and lawyer associations in the pilot areas shall actively guide lawyers to participate in the multi-dimensional resolution of disputes, encourage and recommend lawyers to serve as mediators in people's mediation organizations, arbitration institutions, commercial mediation organizations, and industry mediation organizations, encourage lawyers to use modern technological means to innovate mediation work methods, actively participate in online mediation pilot work, promote lawyers to actively assume social responsibilities and reflect social value, fully mobilize the enthusiasm of lawyers to engage in mediation work, and achieve the sustainable development of lawyer mediation work.

18. Strengthen team management. We shall strengthen training for lawyer mediators in professional ethics, practice discipline, and mediation skills, build a high-level team of mediation lawyers, and ensure the quality of mediation cases. Explore the establishment of assessment, recognition, and incentive mechanisms for lawyers' participation in public welfare mediation. People's Courts, judicial administrative organs, and lawyer associations shall provide material or honorary rewards to outstandingly performing lawyer mediation studios, lawyer mediation center organizations, and lawyer mediators.

19. Strengthen accountability. If a lawyer mediator mediates in violation of the law, violates the disqualification system, leaks the privacy or secrets of the parties, or commits other violations of the law or lawyer professional ethics, he or she shall be limited from or prohibited from engaging in mediation practice for a certain period depending on the severity of the circumstances, or shall be subject to industry sanctions and administrative penalties by the lawyer association or judicial administrative organ in accordance with laws and regulations. The lawyer association shall formulate implementation rules and submit them to the local judicial administrative organ for filing.

20. Strengthen publicity work. People's Courts, judicial administrative organs, and lawyer associations in the pilot areas shall vigorously publicize the role and advantages of the lawyer mediation system, encourage citizens, legal persons, and other organizations to優先選擇律師调解快速有效解決爭議，为律师开展调解工作营造良好执业环境。

21. Strengthen guidance and supervision. The Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice will guide and supervise the pilot work, carefully study the prominent issues existing in the pilot, comprehensively evaluate the actual effects of the pilot plan, summarize the successful experiences of multi-dimensional dispute resolution mechanism reform in various regions, and promote the institutionalization and legalization of the reform practice results.

22. This pilot work shall be conducted in 11 provinces (municipalities directly under the Central Government), including Beijing, Heilongjiang, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Shandong, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, and Sichuan. The pilot provinces (municipalities directly under the Central Government) may conduct pilot work throughout the province (municipality directly under the Central Government) or select certain areas to carry out the pilot work, and the pilot plan shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice for filing.

September 30, 2017
